items.q: Who owns the ad account and social pages?
items.a: 100% yours. We operate purely as growth partners via Meta Business Manager. You retain complete master ownership and 24/7 visibility over all numbers, assets, and billing.

Sales are a collaborative effort (50% marketing acquisition system and 50% your product quality and competitive pricing). What we guarantee 100% is building an airtight system: an irresistible offer, compelling ads, and delivering a verified volume of qualified buyer inquiries backed by monthly reports. When your product is strong, this system directly produces revenue.

items.q: How do you assist if my own staff handles incoming messages?
items.a: Under Sales Launch and Sales Engine, we provide full objection-handling guides and sales scripts to train your admins to turn inquiries into closed deals. If you lack the time, under Sales Machine our internal specialists handle buyer filtering and qualification on your behalf.
